title.en: Introduction to SQC and control charts
title.kn: ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ಪರಿಚಯ

heading.en: Quality is built in, not inspected in

hook.en: No two bottles from a soft-drink plant hold exactly the same amount. Some variation is natural, but a loose valve can push it out of hand. Statistical quality control separates natural variation from trouble before bad bottles pile up.
hook.kn: ಪಾನೀಯ ಘಟಕದ ಎರಡು ಬಾಟಲಿಗಳೂ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಹೊಂದಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಕೆಲವು ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಸಹಜ, ಆದರೆ ಸಡಿಲವಾದ ಕವಾಟ ಅದನ್ನು ಮಿತಿಮೀರಿಸಬಹುದು. ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಸಹಜ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ತೊಂದರೆಯಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Distinguish chance and assignable causes of variation
Distinguish process control and product control
Explain the structure and 3σ limits of a control chart

narration.en: No two bottles from a soft-drink plant hold exactly the same amount. Some variation is natural, but a loose valve can push it out of hand. Statistical quality control separates natural variation from trouble before bad bottles pile up.
narration.kn: ಪಾನೀಯ ಘಟಕದ ಎರಡು ಬಾಟಲಿಗಳೂ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಹೊಂದಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಕೆಲವು ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಸಹಜ, ಆದರೆ ಸಡಿಲವಾದ ಕವಾಟ ಅದನ್ನು ಮಿತಿಮೀರಿಸಬಹುದು. ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರೀಯ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಸಹಜ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ತೊಂದರೆಯಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Statistical quality control (SQC) uses statistical methods to maintain the quality of products. Chance (random) causes are many small, unavoidable causes that give a stable pattern of variation; a process with only chance causes is in statistical control. Assignable causes are specific, identifiable causes (a faulty machine, poor raw material, an untrained worker) that can be detected and removed. Process control controls quality during manufacture with control charts; product control decides whether to accept or reject finished lots by acceptance sampling.
body.kn: ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳು ಅನೇಕ ಸಣ್ಣ, ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲಾಗದ ಕಾರಣಗಳು; ಅವು ಮಾತ್ರ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣಗಳು (ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ ಯಂತ್ರ, ಕಳಪೆ ಕಚ್ಚಾವಸ್ತು) ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಿ ತೆಗೆಯಬಹುದಾದವು. ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆಗಳಿಂದ; ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ ಮಾದರಿಯಿಂದ.

narration.en: Statistical quality control (SQC) uses statistical methods to maintain the quality of products. Chance (random) causes are many small, unavoidable causes that give a stable pattern of variation; a process with only chance causes is in statistical control. Assignable causes are specific, identifiable causes (a faulty machine, poor raw material, an untrained worker) that can be detected and removed. Process control controls quality during manufacture with control charts; product control decides whether to accept or reject finished lots by acceptance sampling.

narration.en: The teacher draws a control chart with its central line and 3σ limits, plots sample points and circles a point that signals an assignable cause.

say.en: A control chart has sample number along the bottom and the quality statistic up the side.
The central line is the average. The upper and lower control limits are 3 standard errors above and below it.
Plot the samples. While they wander between the limits, only chance causes are at work.
Sample 7 jumps above the upper limit. That signals an assignable cause: stop and look for it.
Why 3 sigma? If the process is in control, only 0.27 percent of points fall outside by chance.

body.en: A control chart plots a sample statistic $t$ (mean, range, proportion defective, number of defects) against the sample number, with a central line $CL = E(t)$ and control limits $UCL = E(t) + 3\,SE(t)$, $LCL = E(t) - 3\,SE(t)$ (a negative LCL is taken as 0). If all points lie within the limits, the process is in control; a point outside indicates an assignable cause.
body.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ CL = E(t), UCL = E(t) + 3 SE(t), LCL = E(t) − 3 SE(t). ಎಲ್ಲ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು ಮಿತಿಗಳೊಳಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿದೆ; ಹೊರಗಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣವಿದೆ.

points.en: Variables charts: X̄, R; attribute charts: p, np, c

narration.en: A control chart plots a sample statistic t (mean, range, proportion defective, number of defects) against the sample number, with a central line CL = E(t) and control limits UCL = E(t) + 3,SE(t), LCL = E(t) - 3,SE(t) (a negative LCL is taken as 0). If all points lie within the limits, the process is in control; a point outside indicates an assignable cause.
narration.kn: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ CL = E(t), UCL = E(t) + 3 SE(t), LCL = E(t) − 3 SE(t). ಎಲ್ಲ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು ಮಿತಿಗಳೊಳಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿದೆ; ಹೊರಗಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣವಿದೆ.

caption.en: Why 3σ limits? Move k: the readouts show the chance of a false alarm with k-sigma limits when the process is in control.

narration.en: Narrow limits give many false alarms; wide limits miss real trouble. Shewhart chose three sigma as a practical balance.

tryThis.en: Set k = 2. How many false alarms per 1000 samples?

problem.en: Bottles are filled with mean 500 ml and s.d. 8 ml. Samples of 4 bottles are taken. Find the 3σ control limits for the sample mean and decide about sample means 506 and 513.

steps.en: 506 is inside the limits: in control.
513 > 512: out of control; look for an assignable cause.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Bottles are filled with mean 500 ml and s.d. 8 ml. Samples of 4 bottles are taken. Find the 3σ control limits for the sample mean and decide about sample means 506 and 513.

body.en: Ask: "Can I name it and fix it?" If yes (a tool, a worker, a batch of material), it is assignable. If it is the small, everyday wobble with no single culprit, it is chance.

narration.en: Chance or assignable?. Ask: "Can I name it and fix it?" If yes (a tool, a worker, a batch of material), it is assignable. If it is the small, everyday wobble with no single culprit, it is chance.

points.en: Chance causes: natural, unavoidable; assignable causes: identifiable, removable.

homework.en: Write four advantages of statistical quality control.

narration.en: Recap. Chance causes: natural, unavoidable; assignable causes: identifiable, removable. Process control: control charts; product control: acceptance sampling. Limits: E(t) ± 3 SE(t); negative LCL → 0. A point outside the limits signals an assignable cause.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಕಸ್ಮಿಕ ಕಾರಣಗಳು ಸಹಜ; ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣಗಳು ಪತ್ತೆಹಚ್ಚಬಹುದಾದವು. ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ: ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಕ್ಷೆ; ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ: ಸ್ವೀಕಾರ ಮಾದರಿ. ಮಿತಿಗಳು: E(t) ± 3 SE(t); ಋಣ LCL → 0. ಮಿತಿಯ ಹೊರಗಿನ ಬಿಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಾರಣ ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
